title: Model 2: Position embedding, layernorm, tied output, temperature

cues.en: It is now time to continue building up our GPT two model.
cues.zh: 現在要繼續建立我們的 GPT-2 模型。

cues.en: The code file for this video is copied from model one, and then I added several new features to the model.
cues.zh: 這支影片的程式檔，是從模型一複製而來，再加入幾項新功能。

cues.en: So I will first introduce the additions to the model.
cues.zh: 所以我會先介紹新增的部分。

cues.en: And then we'll switch to Python.
cues.zh: 接著切到 Python。

cues.en: And I will explain all of the mechanics.
cues.zh: 說明所有運作細節。

cues.en: Let me first discuss how position embeddings are incorporated into a language model.
cues.zh: 先談位置嵌入如何融入語言模型。

cues.en: This slide is a reminder of the position embeddings from the previous section.
cues.zh: 這張投影片回顧上一節的位置嵌入。

cues.en: I'm sure you remember this picture here of the learned position embeddings vectors that we plucked out of the trained GPT two model.
cues.zh: 相信你還記得這張圖，是從訓練好的 GPT-2 模型中取出已學習的位置嵌入向量。

cues.en: So as a reminder, the idea of the position embeddings is that they allow the model to weight tokens
cues.zh: 提醒一下，位置嵌入的概念，是讓模型依照詞元

cues.en: differently according to their location in the token sequence.
cues.zh: 在序列中的位置，給予不同的權重。

cues.en: So how do these position embeddings actually work inside the model?
cues.zh: 這些位置嵌入在模型內到底如何運作？

cues.en: In fact, the token embeddings and the position embeddings are literally summed together in the forward pass.
cues.zh: 其實，前向傳播時會直接把詞元嵌入與位置嵌入相加。

cues.en: So literally just adding them together.
cues.zh: 真的就只是加在一起。

cues.en: Here's a very simple example that I will walk through in the code that shows what this looks like.
cues.zh: 這裡有個非常簡單的例子，稍後會在程式碼中逐步說明。

cues.en: So imagine this tensor up here is our embeddings matrix for inputs of two batches, a sequence length
cues.zh: 想像上面的張量是嵌入矩陣，輸入有兩個批次，序列長度

cues.en: of three and an embeddings dimension of four.
cues.zh: 為 3，嵌入維度為 4。

cues.en: Now obviously this is not a realistic matrix size for a language model.
cues.zh: 顯然，這不是實際語言模型會使用的矩陣大小。

cues.en: It's just to show how this addition works.
cues.zh: 只是為了示範這個加法。

cues.en: So this is the embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 這就是嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: And the embeddings dimension is four.
cues.zh: 嵌入維度是 4。

cues.en: And that means that the position embeddings matrix is also of size four.
cues.zh: 因此位置嵌入的大小也要是 4。

cues.en: And I define the position embeddings matrix or vector just to be the numbers zero, one, two, three.
cues.zh: 為了示範，我把位置嵌入矩陣或向量定義成 0、1、2、3。

cues.en: Again, this is not meant to be actual weights, it's just for this demo.
cues.zh: 再次強調，這不是實際權重，只是示範。

cues.en: So then we literally add them together and the combined token plus position embedding would look like this.
cues.zh: 然後直接相加，詞元嵌入加上位置嵌入的結果，就會是這樣。

cues.en: In this toy example.
cues.zh: 這是個玩具範例。

cues.en: Now this is the actual tensor that goes through the model and all the attention heads and MLP, sublayers and so on.
cues.zh: 真正通過模型、各個注意力頭與 MLP 子層等元件的，就是這個張量。

cues.en: The rest of the model has no idea that the token embeddings and position embeddings are actually two separate matrices.
cues.zh: 模型其餘部分並不知道，詞元嵌入與位置嵌入其實是兩個獨立矩陣。

cues.en: Now they really are separate matrices.
cues.zh: 但它們確實是分開的矩陣。

cues.en: Backprop is applied to each of those matrices separately during model training, but it's not the case
cues.zh: 模型訓練時，兩個矩陣會分別接受反向傳播，但並不是

cues.en: that the model processes the token embeddings separately from the position embeddings in the forward pass.
cues.zh: 在前向傳播時，模型會分別處理詞元嵌入和位置嵌入。

cues.en: They're just added together.
cues.zh: 它們就是直接相加。

cues.en: So it's kind of remarkable that it works so well.
cues.zh: 這樣做竟然這麼有效，其實有點令人驚訝。

cues.en: Anyway, another point I would like to note here is that the position embeddings have nothing whatsoever to do with the vocab or the vocab size.
cues.zh: 另外想提醒，位置嵌入與詞彙表、詞彙表大小完全無關。

cues.en: The vocab size determines the token embeddings, but the position embeddings matrix is entirely determined by the sequence length and the sequence length.
cues.zh: 詞彙表大小決定詞元嵌入；位置嵌入矩陣則由序列長度決定。所謂序列長度，

cues.en: That's the number of tokens you enter into a model, and that itself has nothing to do with the vocab size.
cues.zh: 就是輸入模型的詞元數量，本身和詞彙表大小無關。

cues.en: And you can see that here where I initialize these embeddings matrices.
cues.zh: 初始化嵌入矩陣時，就能看出這一點。

cues.en: So the token embeddings that's this line here that's initialized to be of size corresponding to the number of tokens in the vocab.
cues.zh: 詞元嵌入在這一行初始化，其大小對應詞彙表中的詞元數量。

cues.en: And the position embeddings is initialized according to the sequence length and also the embeddings dimension.
cues.zh: 位置嵌入則依序列長度與嵌入維度初始化。

cues.en: There is one more thing I would like to tell you about before we're ready to look at code.
cues.zh: 看程式碼之前，還有一件事要說明。

cues.en: And that is another issue of scaling and in particular scaling the logits.
cues.zh: 也是縮放的問題，特別是 logit 的縮放。

cues.en: You now know from the previous several videos that numerical scaling is important and also tricky in these deep learning models.
cues.zh: 透過前幾支影片，你已知道數值縮放對深度學習模型很重要，也有點棘手。

cues.en: So Layernorm generally handles a lot of the normalizations, but there are some expansions of variants
cues.zh: LayerNorm 一般會處理許多正規化需求，但某些變異數的擴張

cues.en: that are theoretically well behaved, and therefore we can normalize for those expansions of variants using scaling factors that don't need to be learned by the model.
cues.zh: 在理論上具有明確行為，因此可用不需要模型學習的縮放係數，來正規化這些變異數擴張。

cues.en: That's a good thing, because every additional parameter that the model learns needs more training, more data, more computation time, and so on.
cues.zh: 這是好事，因為每多學一個參數，就需要更多訓練、資料、計算時間等等。

cues.en: Anyway, here is a screenshot of the forward pass from the model.
cues.zh: 總之，這是模型前向傳播的截圖。

cues.en: And for right now in particular, I'd like you to direct your attention to this final line here.

cues.zh: 這是前向傳播的結尾，我在這裡把最後的 logit 除以嵌入維度的

cues.en: The Tokenizers are built up separately from the language models, but the token embeddings vectors are
cues.zh: Tokenizer 與語言模型分開建立，但詞元嵌入向量

cues.en: inside the model, and they are learned along with all the other model parameters.
cues.zh: 位於模型內，會和所有其他模型參數一起學習。

cues.en: Now, once the model is fully trained, we can extract the embeddings matrix, play around with it, and investigate that.
cues.zh: 模型完整訓練後，就能取出嵌入矩陣，操作並研究它。

cues.en: We will do more of that later in the course, but it's not trained separately the way that we did in the previous section.
cues.zh: 課程後面還會做更多這類分析，但它不是像上一節那樣分開訓練。

cues.en: Another point that I would like to clarify from previous videos is that the tokens in a sequence are
cues.zh: 另一點要釐清的是，序列裡的詞元在

cues.en: all processed simultaneously in parallel in the model during the feed forward pass.
cues.zh: 模型前向傳播時，是同時並行處理的。

cues.en: When you input a sentence into a GPT model, it is not the case that the model processes each token individually, like in a for loop.
cues.zh: 把句子輸入 GPT 模型時，模型並不是像 for 迴圈那樣，一次處理一個詞元。

cues.en: All of the tokens are processed at the same time.
cues.zh: 所有詞元會同時處理。

cues.en: However, it is also true that the model is processed when the model is processing a given token, it cannot see any of the future tokens.
cues.zh: 但同時也沒錯，模型處理某個詞元時，無法看到任何未來詞元。

cues.en: It can only see the previous tokens.
cues.zh: 它只能看到前面的詞元。

cues.en: But that does not happen in a for loop over tokens.
cues.zh: 不過這不是透過逐一遍歷詞元的 for 迴圈實現。

cues.en: It happens because of the causal mask that is built into the self-attention mechanism, and that is what you are going to start learning about in the next video.
cues.zh: 而是由自注意力機制內建的因果遮罩達成，下一支影片就會開始介紹。
